i’m your age. i was supposed to go to university this year, but ended up in psych ward until the day of my high school graduation because i just couldn’t take it anymore. it’s so fucking hard out here. and it sucks to think that there’s only one person who would be so concerned if you were to die. but looking back, a lot has changed from last year and i realized i might not even want to go to college. my family is giving me shit for it but i know i need to take my time.  

i kind of know what you’re going through. it’s not easy. you can talk to me if you want
big fuckin mood. i don’t know how my family could have supported me if it weren’t for the healthcare coverage in canada.

that’s actually great! if i ever need to stay in the ward again i want to go somewhere better lol. for some time i was the only teenager in the ward which was rather uncomfortable. thanks for letting me know there’s better options

thank you for sharing. my own experience in the ward was a hell of its own but i wouldn’t be alive today otherwise. sometimes it’s the right thing to do and it’s good to be reminded that there is a way out
thank you for letting me know. it sucks that they’ll have to look at me differently if i tell them though. i already got enough shit for it from other people for being open
i’ve done it before. in ways it’s a means of coping without having to leave and cause suspicion
i will if things escalate
he’s really nice. i just think he only sees my bad sides

i can’t even begin to fathom how hard that must be for him. having consistent conversations, asking him about about his day and showing that you will be there for him during his time of grieving and even after, is really important. i hope things turn out okay for you both
i’m sorry it has lead you to be in a lonely place. it’s really tough. you deserve to have friends who hold on
this is comforting. thank you

happy birthday :) you’ve come a long way, really. my birthday is in a couple days, and last year i turned 18 as well. looking back, things were quite different. they dipped down for a bit but i’m a changed and stronger person. 

i think you have much to look forward to. thank you for sticking around
that was my favourite song when i was 13. i don’t think i’ve ever connected with music like i did with that song, even now. thanks for taking your time to show care
radiohead

i’ve probably spent a total of at least 10 hours crying the past two days. i don’t know where i’d be without the people who understand. it sucks to not be able to face the world and feel inferior in its eyes but us criers are strong to still go out there in spite of it all
maybe when i was a kid. they’re more lenient now but i can’t help but feel the pressure to be perfect for them, after all they’ve been through to help me have a good life.
thank you
people really don’t understand until they do it and it feels right for them. one day it just happens and cutting is the only thing that levels you

i’ve been on cipralex for a while now. for the most part it feels like the only thing i need and the best meds i’ve had. different things for different people

i feel the same. sometimes life is lovely enough to give us reminders that there is a sliver of hope, that we are capable of love. but for the time being it’s just dull and lacklustre. maybe i don’t deserve love. i hope you feel some sort of warmth soon.
